text: In the Galois correspondence for a finite Galois extension E/F with group G, larger subgroups of G correspond to:
choices: nothing — the correspondence does not interact with inclusion
explanation: The bijection H ↦ E^H is inclusion-REVERSING: more automorphisms fix fewer elements. The extremes match up as G ↦ F and {id} ↦ E, and [E^H : F] = [G : H].
